newsitem.title: FRANCE: France says to stick to Thomson-CSF timetable.
newsitem.headline: France says to stick to Thomson-CSF timetable.

text.p: The French Finance Ministry said on Wednesday that it had received firm and final offers for the state's 58-percent stake in Thomson-CSF by Alcatel Alsthom with Dassault Industries and by Lagardere.

"In the current context (of a pending parliamentary election) the government wants no study of these offers to start before the end of the month," the statement said. The two-round poll will take place on May 25 and June 1.

"For obvious reasons of confidentiality, no comment whatsoever will be made by the public authorities until after the selection of the final buyer. Such confidentiality has also been imposed on the candidates."
"The aim to procede -- after advice by the Privatisation Commission -- to the choice of a buyer before the end of June 1997 is confirmed."
